capabilities: Mirror the whole vault to a pCloud folder in both directions
Merge Markdown notes edited on two devices paragraph by paragraph
Sync Obsidian settings across devices while keeping plugin lists per device
Quarantine deleted or overwritten files for 30 days and restore them
Preview syncs, log activity, and pause before mass deletions or conflicts
extras: Source is developed in a private repository made available to the Obsidian team for community-directory verification; can be installed early via BRAT; quarantine data is removed if the plugin is uninstalled; manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian offers no built-in way to sync a vault through a user's own pCloud storage, and plain file copying loses edits when two devices change the same note.

relations.evidence: no other server is involved, and nothing is sent anywhere except to the pCloud account you log into

summary: Vault syncing plugin that mirrors the whole vault to a pCloud folder and merges notes edited on two devices paragraph by paragraph.
